mentions.name: Tella Stories
mentions.description: Tella Stories is a personalized storytelling app for kids that generates stories from the child's actual life — their family, friends, pets, and the things they're nervous about that week — so the story is about their world and imagination and grows with them. It leverages multiple AI services to create the stories, gives kids agency through choices instead of passively watching, avoids an educational/instructional approach, and aims for Bluey-level quality as a trustworthy, enjoyable screen-time alternative.
mentions.problem: Existing kids' personalization apps deliver templated digital stories or upsell printed versions, and most screen time is algo/curated garbage; parents lack a high-quality digital storytelling experience they can trust and kids actually enjoy.
